story.title: The Stolen Silhouettes
story.logline: When a teenager investigates why her mother casts three distinct shadows on the wet pavement, she uncovers a horrifying truth about her own heart.
story.theme: Parental sacrifice and the hidden cost of staying alive.
story.twist: The extra shadows aren't being cast by her mother, but are trailing the teenager herself because she died at birth and is kept alive by three unborn siblings.
story.ending: A chilling realization that leaves the viewer questioning what unseen forces are keeping them alive.

scenes.narration: My mother walks with three distinct shadows tonight, and absolutely none of them match her standing body on this street.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized bright yellow rain jacket and worn grey jeans, walking on a dark, rain-slicked suburban street lined with flickering yellow streetlights. She looks down in shock as her mother's figure casts three separate dark shadows on the wet asphalt pavement.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking shot moving slowly backward

scenes.narration: Every single time we pass beneath a flickering streetlight, those dark silhouettes stretch across wet asphalt like desperate, reaching hands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic close-up on the wet asphalt pavement under a flickering yellow streetlight. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail in a bright yellow rain jacket, stands on the dark suburban street, watching three elongated, claw-like dark shadows stretch outwards across the puddle-covered ground.
scenes.camera: High angle tilt down onto the pavement

scenes.narration: I already knew about the city's illegal shadow trade, where desperate people sell off pieces of their souls for cash.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized bright yellow rain jacket and grey jeans, standing on the rainy, dark suburban street, staring intensely at torn black-market flyers pasted on a wet streetlight pole.

scenes.narration: I honestly believed Mom was selfish. I thought she bought extra silhouettes to absorb her own relentless, crippling joint pain.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, yellow rain jacket, and grey jeans, walking behind her limping mother on the dark, rain-slicked suburban street under glowing yellow streetlights.

scenes.narration: So late tonight, while she slept on our worn couch, I finally pried open the heavy locked journal in her coat.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Inside a dimly lit hallway overlooking the rainy suburban street outside. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized bright yellow rain jacket, stealthily opens a dusty leather journal under flickering yellow light.

scenes.narration: The ink-stained pages weren't financial receipts. They were old hospital records for three unborn children she lost long ago.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 over-the-shoulder shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail in a bright yellow rain jacket, staring at yellowed medical certificates inside a leather journal. The rainy suburban street is visible through a nearby window under streetlight glow.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on text and Maya's reaction

scenes.narration: My lungs shattered on the final entry: three lost souls permanently tethered together just to power one dying baby girl.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic portrait shot. Extreme close-up on Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail and wide brown eyes, her face illuminated by yellow light. Tear-streaked face inside her bright yellow rain jacket hood, holding the open journal with a dark rainy street visible outside.

scenes.narration: Terrified, I backed out the front door and stepped directly into the glaring yellow beam of the overhead streetlamp.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized bright yellow rain jacket and grey jeans, stepping outside onto the dark, rain-slicked suburban street directly under a bright yellow overhead streetlight beam.

scenes.narration: I looked down at the rain-slicked concrete pavement. I didn't cast a single shadow of my own; I never had.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 top-down shot looking directly at Maya's feet. Maya, an 18-year-old girl wearing worn grey jeans and muddy boots, standing directly under a bright yellow streetlight on wet asphalt pavement. She casts zero shadow beneath her feet, while three separate dark silhouettes loom behind her.

scenes.narration: When you walk home beneath the glowing streetlamps tonight, how many stolen shadows are secretly keeping your cold heart beating?
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic portrait shot. Maya, an 18-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail in a bright yellow rain jacket, looking directly into the camera lens on a dark, rain-slicked suburban street. Three dark silhouettes loom silently on the pavement behind her under flickering streetlights.

caption.hook: Three shadows. Two people. One impossible truth.
caption.title: The Stolen Silhouettes
caption.caption: Mom always said we were inseparable, walking together under the flickering streetlights of a rain-slicked city. But when I finally looked down at the wet pavement and counted the darkness stretching behind us, I realized I was never meant to be alive at all. What is truly keeping you tethered to this world?
